# fcm-conformant — CONFORMANT CONTROL for the fcm-delivery family

The specificity arm of the AC4 pair. Identical declaration to `fcm-declared-absent.md`;
the only difference is that the declared path is present as an `A` row in the diff set.
A probe whose control arm also fires is a broken probe, so this fixture is not decoration:
it is what makes the must-flag arm mean something.
